name: number porting
label: Number porting

modes.title: Number transfers delayed
modes.symptom: number transfers passing their promised date without completing
customer_says: I was told my old number would move across by now, and it still hasn't.
My number transfer is overdue. I'm still on the temporary number you gave me.
I gave you my switching code, and my number still hasn't come over.
The port of my number was meant to be done by now and nothing has happened.

causes.cause: a stalled batch at the central porting clearing system
fixes: resubmitting the stalled batch to the porting clearing system

causes.cause: a validation fault that rejected switching codes containing a zero
fixes: correcting the switching code validation and replaying the rejected requests

causes.cause: a scheduling service that skipped a day of port requests

workarounds: keep using the temporary number and share it with close contacts
leave the old SIM in a spare phone to keep receiving calls on the old number
aftercare: restart the phone once the transfer text arrives
tell contacts that the temporary number will stop working

modes.title: Calls still reaching the old network
modes.symptom: transferred numbers still ringing on the old network
customer_says: My number has moved to you, but calls to it still go to my old SIM.
People ring my number and it rings my old phone, not the Meridian one.
The transfer is supposed to be finished, and yet incoming calls aren't reaching my new SIM.
I can make calls from my number on the new SIM, but I can't receive any.

causes.cause: a routing update that was not sent to the other networks
fixes: broadcasting the missing routing update to the other networks

causes.cause: a number range database that failed to replicate
fixes: forcing the number range database to replicate

causes.cause: an interconnect partner still holding an old routing table
fixes: getting the interconnect partner to load the new routing table

workarounds: keep the old SIM active in a second phone for incoming calls
set a divert on the old SIM to the temporary Meridian number
aftercare: ask a friend on another network to make a test call
remove the divert from the old SIM before disposing of it

modes.title: Texts not arriving after transfer
modes.symptom: transferred numbers receiving calls but not text messages
customer_says: Since my number moved over I get calls, but no texts. Bank codes aren't arriving.
I've ported my number, and now text messages just don't reach me.
Calls work on my transferred number, but texts from other networks vanish.
I'm not receiving any text messages since I switched to you and kept my number.

causes.cause: a message routing table missing the newly transferred numbers
fixes: adding the transferred numbers to the message routing table

causes.cause: a text hub partner that had not received the port notifications
fixes: resending the port notifications to the text hub partner

causes.cause: a home location entry left pointing at the previous network
fixes: correcting the home location entries for the transferred numbers

workarounds: choose voice call or email for security codes where the sender offers it
ask contacts to use an internet messaging app for the time being
aftercare: send a text to the number from another phone to check delivery
ask senders to resend any code that did not arrive

modes.title: Switching codes not issued
customer_says: I texted for my switching code a while ago and nothing has come back.
I asked for the code to move my number, and I haven't received it by text or email.
The short number for a switching code isn't replying at all.
I've requested my transfer code three times now and had no reply.

causes.cause: a code generation service that lost access to the account system
fixes: reconnecting the code generation service to the account system

causes.cause: a short number that was unassigned during a tidy-up of text routes
fixes: reassigning the short number to the code service

causes.cause: a reply template rejected as spam by the message centre
fixes: approving the reply template at the message centre

workarounds: request the switching code from the account settings in the portal
ask an adviser to read the switching code out after passing security
aftercare: use the newest code received, because earlier ones are cancelled
allow one working day for the code to become active with the new network

wrong_customer_side: a switching code typed in wrongly
an old account that still has a balance to pay
a handset locked to the previous network
a SIM card that was never activated
wrong_provider_side: the previous network refusing to release the number
a weekend backlog at the porting desk
an industry-wide freeze on number transfers
a regulator's audit pausing all switches
